A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Little details, cleared up.

Is every worksheet really free?

Yes. Generate, download and print without an account, subscription or download quota. You can use the worksheets at home or in your classroom.

Can I print a full week at once?

Select Weekly pack and generate. The PDF includes five fresh worksheets. When the answer-key option is selected, each worksheet is followed by its answer page. The preview shows Day 1.

Do US, UK and India settings change the curriculum?

Region selects a convenient paper size: Letter for US, A4 for UK and India. The activities are skill-based, not mapped to a specific curriculum. Spelling uses the words you enter.

What happens to names or words I enter?

They stay in the current browser page and generated download. This studio does not transmit entries to a server, use AI APIs, or save them to browser storage. Refreshing clears the form.

How do I save a PDF with non-Latin text?

Use Print and select Save as PDF in your browser. The direct PDF download uses Latin fonts. Word searches currently accept English A–Z letters only.
